readerCopy.body: The urge to break free can be accurate about the problem and reckless about what should replace it. When Uranus squares the North Node, disruption and forward movement create friction, making the old setup impossible to tolerate before the replacement is stable, affordable, or complete. A sudden exit can remove the restriction and support at the same time. The next direction becomes stronger when the intolerable part is identified precisely enough that change does not have to destroy everything around it.
